shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g '*lock*' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'components/**' -g 'index.html' -g '*config*' -g 'README*'"
/bin/bash -lc "ls -la && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' /home/sandbox 2>/dev/null"

/bin/bash -lc "cat tsconfig.json && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit | rg '(theme|ThemeProvider|useTheme)' | head -35 && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui && rg --files /home/sandbox/workspace/__agent_eval__ && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeValue.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts && cat index.html && cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'

/bin/bash -lc "node -e \"try { console.log(require.resolve('playwright')) } catch { console.log('no playwright') } try { console.log(require.resolve('@playwright/test')) } catch { console.log('no playwright test') }\""
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -d /tmp/* /opt/* /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/* /home/sandbox/.cache/ms-playwright/* 2>/dev/null | head -45 && which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>/dev/null'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install --prefix /tmp/pulse-browser playwright --no-audit --no-fund'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0'
/bin/bash -lc '/tmp/pulse-browser/node_modules/.bin/playwright install chromium'
/bin/bash -lc 'git diff --stat && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc '/tmp/pulse-browser/node_modules/.bin/playwright install-deps chromium'
/bin/bash -lc 'id && cat /etc/os-release && command -v sudo && sudo -n true && echo available'
/bin/bash -lc "ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1248/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome | rg 'not found'"

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p /tmp/pulse-libs && cd /tmp/pulse-libs && apt-get download libglib2.0-0 libnspr4 libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libatk-bridge2.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libcups2 libxkbcommon0 libasound2 libgbm1 libcairo2 libpango-1.0-0 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libatspi2.0-0'
/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.js && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProviderBody.js 2>/dev/null'

/bin/bash -lc 'for package_file in /tmp/pulse-libs/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$package_file" /tmp/pulse-libs/root; done
LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/pulse-libs/root/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1248/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome | rg '"'not found'"

/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/pulse-libs && apt-get download libavahi-common3 libavahi-client3 libdrm2 libwayland-server0 libpixman-1-0 libfontconfig1 libfreetype6 libpng16-16 libxcb-shm0 libxcb-render0 libxrender1 libfribidi0 libthai0 libharfbuzz0b libxi6 libgraphite2-3 libdatrie1 libbrotli1 libexpat1'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm exec --yes --package prettier -- prettier --write src/App.tsx src/styles.css index.html'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'
/bin/bash -lc "git diff --check && rg -n 'const daily|inheritedTheme|const values|chart-tooltip|sidebar \\{' src/App.tsx src/styles.css"
/bin/bash -lc "ls -lh /tmp/pulse-libs/*.deb | tail -8 && ps -eo pid,etime,args | rg 'apt-get download'"

/bin/bash -lc 'for package_file in /tmp/pulse-libs/*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$package_file" /tmp/pulse-libs/root; done
